'''Lightsaber training staffs''' were staffs used in the place of real [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] who had not yet constructed their own blades. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] [[Petro/Legends|Petro]] practiced with a training staff while he was on board the [[Jedi training cruiser/Legends|Jedi training cruiser]] [[Crucible/Legends|''Crucible'']], deflecting shots from a [[Marksman-H combat remote]] and then showing his fellow trainees an original move he had created named the "[[Whirlwind of Destiny/Legends|Whirlwind of Destiny]]."<ref name="ATOS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lightsaber training staffs first appeared in [[2012]] in ''[[A Test of Strength]]'', the seventh episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth]] season of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', the script for which was written by [[Christian Taylor]]. The staffs were also mentioned in the Episode gallery for the episode on [[StarWars.com]].
